atoms.name: Hash functions and load factor
atoms.one_line: h(k)=k mod m maps keys to slots; load factor is n/m; two keys in one slot is a collision.

atoms.name: Chaining
atoms.one_line: Colliding keys share a linked list; expected chain length is alpha; unsuccessful search costs about alpha comparisons.

atoms.name: Linear probing
atoms.one_line: Try h, h+1, h+2 and so on, wrapping around; the final table depends on insertion order.

atoms.name: Quadratic probing and double hashing
atoms.one_line: Probe i goes to (h1+i^2) or (h1+i*h2) mod m; the step must reach every slot.

atoms.name: Expected probes under uniform hashing
atoms.one_line: Unsuccessful search or insertion about 1/(1-alpha); successful search about (1/alpha)ln(1/(1-alpha)); alpha<1.

atoms.name: Insertion orders and probability
atoms.one_line: Which orders give a table (precedence constraints) and the chance that slots stay empty.

atoms.name: Choosing a hash scheme
atoms.one_line: Division, multiplication and universal hashing; uniform spread of keys; dynamic hashing by key bits.
